A''' Barabel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] prisoner and trustee guard in the [[Kessel prison|Imperial Correctional Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He only had one [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and was known to be very brutal to the prisoners.<ref name="kessel" />

During one particular mealtime, the Barabel chose to make a disciplinary example of [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Unidentified Sullustan (Kessel)|prisoner]], who was under the protection of another prisoner, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gyylghrard]]. A fight ensued between the guard and the Wookiee, which ended with the guard being sent to the infirmary due to his injuries. The Barabel plotted revenge on Gyylghrard but it is not known whether his plans had anything to do with [[Moruth Doole]]'s&mdash;the most powerful trustee in the mines&mdash;punishment of Gyylghrard, which saw the Wookiee attacked by more than five assailants, then sent to solitary confinement without any treatment to his injuries.<ref name="kessel" />
